full_target:
Common setting: small rye plot beside the road to Severny Dvor, late summer. West boundary is cut stubble and compacted dry clay road; an elm boundary stake at northwest; a wooden two-wheeled handcart at the west edge, moved back along the road after edge inspection; standing rye remains to east, low alder grove and growing grey cloud behind it. Midday warm diffuse sun from upper west; afternoon warmth lowers gradually in E03 only. No rain in any pictured moment. No relocation of road, elm stake or grove with camera angle.

Fixed cast:
- **Rada**, adult 31, lean working build, angular face, dark brown hair in one braid under dull ochre linen headscarf. Faded charcoal-grey coarse linen shirt, earth-brown wool skirt to mid-calf, dull flax apron, brown ankle boots; patched right elbow. Lower lip split (exact corner is not established by player text and is NOT_VERIFIABLE in current small reference) from the attempted rescue before story; short dark dried blood line only at the corner, no fresh red coat or clean reset. Dust at hem, knees and palms persists. Iron sickle: simple inward-curved darkened blade, plain ash handle; no ornament, no sword.
- **Luka**, adult 49, sturdy and stooped, thinning grey-brown hair, short greying beard. Undyed flax shirt with worn cuffs, dark umber sleeveless wool over-tunic, charcoal trousers, brown calf boots, plain narrow leather belt. Dry dust at boots/hem, straw on cuffs after trial; no armour, noble finery or magically immaculate change of clothes. Sweat at collar accumulates by E03; not drenched.
- **Timosh**, adult 19 (young, not a child), slim, short straight dark hair, clean-shaven. Faded clay-beige linen shirt, narrow dark-grey trousers, brown boots, simple rope belt. Shirt sleeves rolled once at forearms. No weapon; handles rope, cart and harvested stalks. Same hands/clothing in every view; no new cut or bandage.
- **One dead worker**, adult male, rough dull brown shirt slit from throat to upper chest by the established attack; dark grey trousers/boots. Face covered by the same dark cap, then by plain unbleached linen sheet on cart. Body was already pulled onto the stubble before arrival; no living character approaches the creature to retrieve him. Death is recent, not a revenant: no decomposition timeline or postmortem motion.
- **Creature**, one local encounter: 2.1m target upright height, unnaturally long continuous arms, narrow torso under weathered flax-coloured hanging garment, grey clay-coloured non-reflective skin; matted dark hair covers the face. Two arms/two hands, long jointed fingers with dark nails, no extra limbs, antlers, wings, sickle or glowing runes. Character appears through the rye, never smiling toward the viewer or posing as a healthy woman. Do not mirror anatomy to copy a shot. It may bend below rye without vanishing magically. Head orientation follows nearest exposed hand/shield rather than camera.
- **Shields**, two company-owned plain ROUND timber shields already on the cart from arrival; weathered dark wood, simple iron rim, leather forearm straps/central grip. First shield gets fresh gouges at edge inspection; second initially intact. Both remain serviceable; neither is shattered or repaired between cuts. No protagonist sword needs to be displayed. If player hand appears, use only the required connected hand/forearm; do not invent multiple identical soldiers for «company».

Distinct pictured instants:
1. **start:** Timosh kneels on stubble, anatomical LEFT hand lowering the cap over the dead face, RIGHT hand braced on his own knee; no palm pressed into chest wound. Rada on cart shaft holds her left hand to lip and sickle low in right, blade pointing away from Timosh. Luka stands behind the cart, looking down at emptied bread bag; hands empty. Body lies fully on cut ground, feet away from rye. The threat is hidden; nobody looks calmly into it at touching distance.
2. **witness:** Rada stands beside cart, right hand gripping Timosh's left wrist before he touches the cap; her left hand points toward rye. Sickle rests flat on cart bed with point inward, not in the same hand. Timosh has stopped, weight leaning back. Luka watches the siblings from the road and remains visible in the wider crop. Exact moment: wrist stopped, both connected arms and sickle resting place visible.
3. **edge:** immediately after withdrawal, one gouged shield held low in foreground/left by a connected player forearm or entirely outside crop if no readable grip can be staged. Creature half-risen behind rye east, its nearest open hand still at the crop boundary; no contact presently required. Luka arrives from west with intact second shield, kept outside crop. Rada/Timosh by the moved cart farther back; eyes on threat, no generic frontal portrait. No illustration of winning harvest yet.
4. **trial:** after the first retreat, all at moved cart. Luka crouched on stubble, failed binding at his boots: right hand loose cord, left open above straw; both feet planted. Timosh kneels opposite tying the same cord with two different hands. Rada standing behind them touches her split lip with left hand, sickle safely in right pointed down. Gouged and intact shields lean against cart away from body. Creature not needed in this human pause; same rye/elm/road topology visible.
5. **terms:** Luka at covered body on stubble, right hand adjusting cap by its hem without exposing face; second shield lies flat on road behind his boots; left hand rests on own thigh. Rada stands at his left, LEFT hand on first tied sheaf, sickle flat on cart bed; Timosh stands near cart at safe road side with empty hands; no grip or pulling in this moment. Exact moment: Luka has agreed to carry the dead man's share, not already delivered it. Overcast edge visible above grove, dry materials unchanged.
6. **leave:** a later moment after loading: dead body fully shrouded on cart; only its human outline and boot tips if needed, no healthy face. Luka and Timosh grip separate cart handles from west/road side, backs strained naturally, feet on road; Rada behind holding her single sickle low in right hand, blade pointing away from bodies. Warning belt between two new roadside stakes at field entrance, elm stake remains separate. Crop remains standing, no implied harvest if trial skipped.
7. **edgeHarvest:** stopping after narrow cut, Rada squats on stubble dividing sheaves into three visible loose groups; no numerical economic rule implied. Sickle lies on cart beside rope. Luka holds the STATIONARY cart handles with both feet planted, waiting while Rada divides. This exact instant is BEFORE her next action placing the dead worker share in the cart. Dead worker already shrouded on cart, separate sheaves still on ground or held by Timosh; no claim that grain is loaded yet. Timosh stands by the last group with a sheaf in both hands, never pressed into standing rye. Creature partly seen at remaining crop edge, beyond reach, no celebratory grin.
8. **sharedHarvest:** dry warm late-afternoon low light; full cart of sheaves and shrouded worker at separate front end, lashing holds both. Luka stands by grove path with a bound sheaf on right shoulder, right hand under stalks, left steadying at chest, weight under feet. Rada seated on cart shaft with empty open hands, Timosh catches her lowered sickle by the handle; image may select instant immediately after catch so sharp blade does not pass through fingers. Two used shields lean on the same cart side, first gouges persist. Marked central crop patch remains beyond stubble; monster threat is unresolved, no dead monster trophy.
